english.title: Driver of a motor vehicle / cyclist stop on the carriageway without authority within a Mersey Tunnel
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels' approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_
(C)_[a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel,]_
(D)_[a cyclist on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel,]_

failed to proceed on the carriageway without stopping unless otherwise authorised or directed by a Mersey Tunnels police officer or other authorised officer or by any traffic sign or prevented from doing so by traffic conditions or other unavoidable cause
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(k) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
